scope: M0 desktop interface for no-mutation exact-byte duplicate evidence scanning and honest timestamp-boundary disclosure

platform_matrix.design_guidance: Repository desktop safety model, platform-app guidance, and native macOS interaction conventions
platform_matrix.fallback_notes: Unknown filesystem capability, incomplete scan, path ambiguity, mount identity change, or content conflict remains report-only and cannot authorize a mutation. Reading may update filesystem-managed atime.

direction.name: 档案纸上的校验台账
direction.north_star: 让每个整理结论像一份可检查的档案记录，而不是要求用户盲信的清理按钮。
direction.signature_device: 纵向证据脊柱串联大小、抽样指纹、完整 BLAKE3、扫描逐字节确认与未来执行前复核。

entrypoints.open_instructions: From the repository root run pnpm install, then pnpm tauri:dev. Build the debug app and DMG with pnpm exec tauri build --debug.
Open design-direction.md together with the repository design-system/tokens.tokens.json and src/App.css implementation.

design_direction.notes: Scoped M0 direction, grammar, signature evidence spine, anti-goals, states, and safety language are documented.

token_source.notes: Canonical repository source is design-system/tokens.tokens.json and is owned with the production UI.

token_export.notes: Canonical generated target export is src/styles/tokens.css; pnpm tokens:check verifies synchronization.

contrast_evidence.notes: Representative opaque role pairs cover body text, controls, focus, and warning text.

component_source.notes: Production component and state source is src/App.tsx with styling in src/App.css and src/index.css.

accessibility.notes: Repository tests/ui/app.spec.ts owns axe and keyboard checks; VoiceOver manual coverage is explicitly limited.

icon_source.notes: Functional icons use lucide-react under ISC and the in-product brand mark is original; packaged app icons remain scaffold defaults and are a declared limitation.

implementation_source.notes: Production sources are src, src-tauri, and crates/guiying-core; this package records the handoff without copying those sources.

image_generation.notes: The interface is implemented directly from the product safety model; no generated UI raster reference is used.

browser_rendering.notes: Playwright renders explicitly labelled synthetic-data states for responsive, keyboard, contrast, and accessibility checks.

figma.notes: No Figma artifact was requested; the canonical implementation and design system live in the repository.

native_runner.notes: The Tauri app was launched, captured in a native macOS window, and bundled as an app and DMG.

image_inspection.notes: All current browser captures, including paged and expanded raw-metadata states, plus the native-window capture were decoded and inspected at full size.

qa.notes: Automated and native evidence passed where mapped; real external-volume dialog flow, VoiceOver, and final branded app icon remain explicit limitations.

sources.notes: Repository provenance, dependency licenses, non-copy boundaries, and synthetic-data hygiene are recorded.

handoff.notes: Stack mapping, source ownership, commands, capability boundaries, and milestone constraints are recorded.
